decisions.reason: As a recently launched core hardware product in the firm’s main business, it is likely to be retained because sunk development and launch costs are still salient and there is no clear evidence yet that weak demand is permanent.
A door lever handle family represents a broader platform commitment in the firm’s established range, so management is likely to continue backing it rather than reverse course so soon after launch.
Although a single new handle design could be easier to prune than a full family, escalation of commitment and the normal trial period after launch make withdrawal within a year still unlikely.

This design variant is close to the firm’s core offering and has only just been introduced, so management would probably attribute any early disappointment to temporary market acceptance issues and keep it.
Because it is another newly launched door lever handle family in the established product domain, the firm is likely to preserve it to justify its investment and public product-range commitment.

The electronic access system received a specific and prominent launch claim on the website, indicating visible strategic commitment and making management especially reluctant to abandon it after only one year.
